Let no one be astonished at this exalted word. The Son of Mary, upon him be the peace of God and the peace of His Prophets, saw a fisherman occupied in catching fish. He said, “Put down the net and come, so that I may make you a fisher of humanity.” After these words, though tongue-tied, he gained speech; though ignorant, he entered the ocean of knowledge; though poor, he found his way to the kingdom of wealth; though abased, he set his sights on the summit of glory; though astray, he attained the light of the dawn of guidance. For he renounced himself and joined himself to God. He burned his desires in the fire of love and tore the veils apart with the finger of certitude. As long as he was in this world, he spoke in remembrance of the Spirit of God, and when he turned toward the world beyond, he attained a station that the pens of the world are powerless to describe. Blessed are those souls whom neither the doubts of those who turn away, nor the insinuations of the deniers, nor the clamor of the people of the Bayān have prevented today from reaching the Desire of all existence. Today is the day of steadfastness and the day of service. Strive, so that you may attain what is mentioned in God’s presence and inscribed in the Book. Glory be upon you and upon everyone who is firm and steadfast. End.
:::

### 58

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این فضل اعظم را نه ببحور میتوان تشبیه نمود و نه بامطار و نه باوراق اشجار و نه برمول صحرا و نه بذرّات کائنات آیا عباد مقبلین و موحّدین و مخلصین چگونه از عهدهٴ شکر برآیند نعمتیکه احصاء آن مشکل است شکر آنهم البتّه فوق عرفان بشر است چون فضلش و رحمتش سبقت یافت اذن عطا فرمود و این سبب بزرگ و علّة اعظم شد از برای ذاکرین و مخلصین و موحّدین والّا مقام خاک کجا و روح پاک کجا چه مناسبت چه مشابهت چه مشاکلت معدوم صرفیم و باراده‌اش موجود هر نفسی را آنمحبوب ذکر نمود بفیوضات نامتناهی فائز گشت مخصوص هر یک بحری از آیات جاری این خادم فانی از حقّ میطلبد مذکورین را تأیید فرماید بر آنچه امروز شایسته و پسندیده است
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn fażl-e aʿẓam rā na be-boḥūr mītavān tashbīh namūd va na be-amṭār va na be-avrāq-e ashjār va na be-romūl-e ṣaḥrā va na be-dharrāt-e kāʾenāt. Āyā ʿebād-e moqbelīn va movaḥḥedīn va mokhleṣīn chegūne az ʿohde-ye shokr barāyand? Neʿmatī ke eḥṣā-ye ān moshkel ast shokr-e ān ham albatte fawq-e ʿerfān-e bashar ast. Chon fażlash va raḥmatash sebqat yāft edhn ʿaṭā farmūd va īn sabab-e bozorg va ʿellat-e aʿẓam shod az barā-ye dhākerīn va mokhleṣīn va movaḥḥedīn. Va-ellā maqām-e khāk kojā va rūḥ-e pāk kojā? Che monāsebat, che moshābahat, che moshākelat? Maʿdūm-e ṣerfīm va be-erāde-ash mawjūd. Har nafsī rā ān Maḥbūb dhekr namūd be-foyūżāt-e nāmotanāhī fāʾez gasht. Makhṣūṣ-e har yek baḥrī az āyāt jārī. Īn khādem-e fānī az Ḥaqq mīṭalabad madhkūrīn rā taʾyīd farmāyad bar ānche emrūz shāyeste va pasandīde ast.
:::

::: {.translation}
This supreme grace cannot be likened to oceans, nor to rains, nor to the leaves of trees, nor to the sands of the desert, nor to the atoms of creation. How can His servants who turn toward Him, acknowledge His oneness, and are sincere discharge their duty of gratitude? A bounty that is difficult to enumerate is certainly also beyond human understanding to thank Him for. Since His grace and mercy took precedence, He granted permission, and this became a great means and a supreme cause for those who remember Him, are sincere, and acknowledge His oneness. Otherwise, how far apart are the station of dust and the pure Spirit! What relationship, what resemblance, what likeness is there? We are sheer nonexistence, brought into being by His will. Every soul whom that Beloved mentioned attained boundless outpourings of grace. For each one in particular, an ocean of verses flows. This transient servant asks God to assist those mentioned in doing what is fitting and acceptable today.
:::

### 59

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ اولیای ن‌ی علیهم بهآء اللّه از ذکور و اناث ذکر نمودند و همچنین ذکر نفوسیکه بادای حقوق فائز گشتند کل در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد و هر یک بذکر مقصود عالمیان فائز و باشراقات انوار آفتاب فضل مزیّن قوله جلّ جلاله و عمّ نواله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye awliyā-ye Nūn-Yāʾ, ʿalayhim bahāʾu Allāh, az dhokūr va enāth dhekr namūdand va hamchenīn dhekr-e nofūsī ke be-adā-ye Ḥoqūq fāʾez gashtand, koll dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā ʿarż shod va har yek be-dhekr-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān fāʾez va be-eshrāqāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e fażl mozayyan. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿamma nawāluhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you mentioned concerning the friends in Nūn-Yāʾ, upon them be the glory of God, both men and women, and likewise your mention of those souls who attained the privilege of paying the Ḥuqūq, was all presented at the most exalted, most holy, most inaccessible Court. Each one was favored with mention by the Desire of all worlds and adorned with the radiance of the sun of grace. His words—exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty:
:::

### 60

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو النّاظر من افقه الأعلی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-nāẓiru min ufuqihi al-aʿlā.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the One who watches from His most exalted horizon.
:::

### 61

::: {.original lang="fa"}
دوستان الهی را تکبیر میرسانیم و ببحر عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله بشارت میدهیم ای اهل نون و یا طوبی لکم و نعیماً لکم چه که از اوّل امر فائز شدید بآنچه که من علی الأرض از آن غافل بودند در سبیل حقّ وارد شد بر شما آنچه که سبب حزن ملأ اعلی گشت آنچه فی سبیل اللّه وارد شود و آنچه شده کل در کتاب الهی از قلم اعلی مذکور و مسطور این بشارتیست بزرگ از برای شما هیچ عملی ضایع نشده و اجرش عنداللّه مخزون زود است مکافات و جزای کل ظاهر و هویدا شود جناب امین ذکر شما را نموده از قبل و بعد بذکر الهی فائز بوده و هستید وصیّت مینمائیم شما را بآنچه که سبب اعلاء کلمة اللّه است با کمال اتّحاد و اتّفاق بذکر حقّ ناطق باشید و بخدمتش مشغول خدمت حقّ جلّ جلاله تبلیغ امر و هدایت ناس بوده و خواهد بود و این حاصل نشود مگر باخلاق راضیه و اعمال طیّبه و شفقت و محبّت از حقّ میطلبیم کل را تأیید فرماید بر آنچه رضای او در اوست
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dūstān-e ilāhī rā takbīr mīresānīm va be-baḥr-e ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, beshārat mīdahīm. Ey ahl-e Nūn va Yā, ṭūbā lakum wa naʿīman lakum, che ke az avval-e amr fāʾez shodīd be-ānche ke man ʿalā al-arḍ az ān ghāfel būdand. Dar sabīl-e Ḥaqq vāred shod bar shomā ānche ke sabab-e ḥozn-e malaʾ-e aʿlā gasht. Ānche fī sabīli Allāh vāred shavad va ānche shode koll dar ketāb-e ilāhī az qalam-e aʿlā madhkūr va masṭūr. Īn beshāratīst bozorg az barā-ye shomā. Hīch ʿamalī żāyeʿ nashode va ajrash ʿinda Allāh makhzūn. Zūd ast mokāfāt va jazā-ye koll ẓāher va hoveydā shavad. Janāb-e Amīn dhekr-e shomā rā namūde. Az qabl va baʿd be-dhekr-e ilāhī fāʾez būde va hastīd. Vaṣiyyat mīnamāyīm shomā rā be-ānche ke sabab-e eʿlā-ye kalematuʾllāh ast. Bā kamāl-e etteḥād va ettefāq be-dhekr-e Ḥaqq nāṭeq bāshīd va be-khedmatash mashghūl. Khedmat-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, tablīgh-e amr va hedāyat-e nās būde va khvāhad būd va īn ḥāṣel nashavad magar be-akhlāq-e rāżīye va aʿmāl-e ṭayyebe va shafaqat va maḥabbat. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm koll rā taʾyīd farmāyad bar ānche reżā-ye ū dar ūst.
:::

::: {.translation}
We convey greetings of praise to the friends of God and give them glad tidings of the ocean of the favor of God, exalted be His glory. O people of Nūn and Yā, blessed are you, and bliss be yours, for from the beginning of the Cause you attained that of which those on earth were heedless. In the path of God, you suffered what brought sorrow to the Concourse on high. Whatever may befall you in the path of God, and whatever has befallen you, is all mentioned and inscribed in the divine Book by the Most Exalted Pen. This is great glad tidings for you. No deed has been lost, and its reward is stored up with God. Soon the recompense and reward of all will become manifest and evident. His honor Amīn has mentioned you. Before and since, you have been, and remain, favored with divine remembrance. We exhort you to that which exalts the Word of God. In perfect unity and concord, speak in remembrance of God and occupy yourselves with His service. Service to God, exalted be His glory, has been and will remain teaching the Cause and guiding the people. This can be accomplished only through pleasing character, good deeds, compassion, and love. We ask God to assist everyone in doing what meets with His good pleasure.
:::

### 62

::: {.original lang="fa"}
چندی قبل مخصوص جناب ملّا محمّد شفیع لوح نازل و ارسال شد و همچنین زیارت حضرت وحید و اولیای حقّ جلّ جلاله امروز روز فرح و شادیست چه که حقّ ظاهر و ندایش مرتفع و افق عالم از نورش منوّر و مزیّن از حقّ طلب استقامت نمائید زود است نعیق ناعق مرتفع شود این خبریست که قلم اعلی از قبل و بعد داده بعضی از اهل بیان بسرقت آیات الهی مشغول و بعضی بدام خضوع و خشوع مترصّد در هر لباسی درآیند که شاید اولیا را بدام کشند از حقّ میطلبیم کل را بطراز استقامت مزیّن دارد بشأنیکه اهل عالم قادر بر منع نباشند خذوا کتاب اللّه بقوّة من عنده انّه یکفیکم بالحقّ ایّاکم ان یمنعکم شیء عن هذا الصّراط المستقیم و هذا النّبأ العظیم الحمد للّه المقتدر الباذل الکریم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Chandī qabl makhṣūṣ-e Janāb-e Mullā Muḥammad-Shafīʿ lawḥ nāzel va ersāl shod va hamchenīn ziyārat-e Ḥażrat-e Vaḥīd va awliyā-ye Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu. Emrūz rūz-e faraḥ va shādīst che ke Ḥaqq ẓāher va nedāyash mortafeʿ va ofoq-e ʿālam az nūrash monavvar va mozayyan. Az Ḥaqq ṭalab-e esteqāmat namāyīd. Zūd ast naʿīq-e nāʿeq mortafeʿ shavad. Īn khabarīst ke qalam-e aʿlā az qabl va baʿd dāde. Baʿżī az ahl-e Bayān be-serqat-e āyāt-e ilāhī mashghūl va baʿżī be-dām-e khożūʿ va khoshūʿ motaraṣṣed. Dar har lebāsī darāyand ke shāyad awliyā rā be-dām kashand. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm koll rā be-ṭerāz-e esteqāmat mozayyan dārad be-shaʾnī ke ahl-e ʿālam qāder bar manʿ nabāshand. Khudhū kitāba Allāhi bi-quwwatin min ʿindihi innahu yakfīkum bi-l-ḥaqqi iyyākum an yamnaʿakum shayʾun ʿan hādhā al-ṣirāṭi al-mustaqīmi wa hādhā al-nabaʾi al-ʿaẓīm. Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi al-muqtadiri al-bādhili al-karīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Some time ago, a Tablet was revealed and sent especially for his honor Mullā Muḥammad-Shafīʿ, as was a Tablet of visitation for his holiness Vaḥīd and the friends of God, exalted be His glory. Today is a day of joy and gladness, for God is manifest, His call is raised, and the horizon of the world is illumined and adorned with His light. Ask God for steadfastness. Soon the cawing of the crier will rise. This is news that the Most Exalted Pen has given before and since. Some of the people of the Bayān are occupied in stealing the divine verses, while others lie in wait with the snare of submissiveness and humility. They assume every guise in the hope of ensnaring the friends. We ask God to adorn everyone with steadfastness in such a manner that the people of the world will be powerless to hinder them. Take hold of the Book of God with strength from Him. He will indeed suffice you in truth. Beware lest anything bar you from this straight path and this momentous announcement. Praise be to God, the All-Powerful, the Munificent, the Generous. End.
:::

### 63

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اهل آن ارض لازال بعنایت حقّ فائز بوده و هستند این ایّام مکتوبی از جناب آقا میرزا جلال و اخوی ایشان علیهما بهآء اللّه رسید انشآءاللّه این خادم فانی مؤیّد شود بر جواب بلسان ظاهر و باطن میطلبم حقّ مددش را قطع نفرماید اوست بر هر شیء مهیمن و محیط
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ahl-e ān arż lā yazāl be-ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq fāʾez būde va hastand. Īn ayyām maktūbī az Janāb-e Āqā Mīrzā Jalāl va akhavī-ye īshān, ʿalayhimā bahāʾu Allāh, resīd. In shāʾ Allāh īn khādem-e fānī moʾayyad shavad bar javāb. Be-lesān-e ẓāher va bāṭen mīṭalabam Ḥaqq madadash rā qaṭʿ nafarmāyad. Ūst bar har shayʾ mohaymen va moḥīṭ.
:::

::: {.translation}
The people of that land have always enjoyed, and continue to enjoy, God’s favor. In recent days, a letter arrived from his honor Āqā Mīrzā Jalāl and his brother, upon them both be the glory of God. God willing, this transient servant will be assisted in replying. With both my outward and inward tongue, I ask that God not withhold His assistance. He is the One who watches over and encompasses all things.
:::

### 64

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و آنچه در ذکر ف‌ت و ابا مرقوم داشتند هر یک از نفوس موقنهٴ ثابته بذکر حقّ فائز شدند طوبی لهم و نعمیاً لهم و چون اینمراتب در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد اینکلمهٴ علیا از لسان ارادهٴ مالک وری ظاهر قوله جلّت عظمته
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va ānche dar dhekr-e Fāʾ-Tāʾ va Abā marqūm dāshtand, har yek az nofūs-e mūqene-ye thābete be-dhekr-e Ḥaqq fāʾez shodand. Ṭūbā lahum wa naʿīman lahum. Va chon īn marāteb dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā ʿarż shod īn kaleme-ye ʿolyā az lesān-e erāde-ye Mālek-e varā ẓāher. Qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to what you wrote in mention of Fāʾ-Tāʾ and Abā, each of the assured and steadfast souls was favored with God’s remembrance. Blessed are they, and bliss be theirs. When these matters were presented at the most exalted, most holy, most inaccessible Court, this exalted word issued from the tongue of the will of the Lord of humanity. His words—exalted be His grandeur:
:::

### 65

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا اباالحسن نامه‌ات که بعبد حاضر نوشتی از این آیهٴ مبارکهٴ قرآن حکایت مینماید لا تغادر فیه صغیرة و لا کبیرة اولیاء الهی در هر دیار که ساکنند ذکرشانرا نمودی و از برای کل اظهار عنایت طلبیدی طوبی لک چه که خیرت احاطه نموده هر یک فائز شدند بآنچه که سزاوار است انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Abā al-Ḥasan, nāme-at ke be-ʿabd-e ḥāżer neveshtī az īn āye-ye mobārake-ye Qurʾān ḥekāyat mīnamāyad: lā tughādiru fīhi ṣaghīratan wa lā kabīratan. Awliyā-ye ilāhī dar har diyār ke sākenand dhekrashān rā namūdī va az barā-ye koll eẓhār-e ʿenāyat ṭalabīdī. Ṭūbā laka, che ke kheyrat eḥāṭe namūde. Har yek fāʾez shodand be-ānche ke sazāvār ast. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Abā al-Ḥasan, the letter you wrote to the servant in attendance reflects this blessed verse of the Qurʾān: “It leaves out therein neither small nor great.” You mentioned the friends of God in every land where they dwell and requested an expression of favor for them all. Blessed are you, for your goodness has encompassed them. Each one has attained what is fitting. End.
:::

### 66

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه ذکر جناب ملّا مهدی و احبّای خ‌وی علیهم بهآء اللّه را نمودند در ساحت امنع اقدس عرض شد هذا ما نزّل لهم من سمآء مشیّة ربّنا و ربّکم و ربّ العرش العظیم قوله جلّ جلاله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dhekr-e Janāb-e Mullā Mahdī va aḥebbā-ye Khūy, ʿalayhim bahāʾu Allāh, rā namūdand dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas ʿarż shod. Hādhā mā nuzzila lahum min samāʾi mashīʾati rabbinā wa rabbikum wa rabbi al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
Your mention of his honor Mullā Mahdī and the friends of Khūy, upon them be the glory of God, was presented at the most holy, most inaccessible Court. This is what was revealed for them from the heaven of the will of our Lord and your Lord, the Lord of the mighty throne. His words—exalted be His glory:
:::

### 67

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو المشفق الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-mushfiqu al-karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Compassionate, the Generous.
:::

### 68

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا مهدی قرّت عین العالم بظهور مکلّم الطّور فی هذا الظّهور و الأمم فی حجاب غلیظ قد ظهر الیوم و اتی من کان موعوداً فی کتب اللّه ربّ العالمین انّه اتی بالحقّ و دعا النّاس الی الأفق الأعلی من النّاس من انکر و اعرض و منهم من سمع و قال لبّیک یا مقصود العارفین و منهم من منعته سطوة الأمرآء و منهم من حجّبته اشارات العلمآء الّذین نبذوا الحقّ ورائهم و کانوا من المعتدین فی کتاب مبین اولئک اتّبعوا اهوائهم و افتوا علی الّذی کانوا ان ینطقوا حین ذکر اسمه عجّل اللّه فرجه کذلک سوّلت لهم انفسهم الا انّهم من الظّالمین بظلمهم ناح اهل الفردوس الأعلی و الجنّة العلیا و اخذ الدّخان سکّان الأرض و السّمآء یشهد بذلک من ینطق انّه لا اله الّا انا الفرد الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Mahdī, qarrat ʿaynu al-ʿālami bi-ẓuhūri Mukallimi al-Ṭūri fī hādhā al-ẓuhūri wa al-umamu fī ḥijābin ghalīẓ. Qad ẓahara al-yawmu wa atā man kāna mawʿūdan fī kutubi Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Innahu atā bi-l-ḥaqqi wa daʿā al-nāsa ilā al-ufuqi al-aʿlā. Mina al-nāsi man ankara wa aʿraḍa wa minhum man samiʿa wa qāla labbayka yā maqṣūda al-ʿārifīn. Wa minhum man manaʿathu saṭwatu al-umarāʾi wa minhum man ḥajjabathu ishārātu al-ʿulamāʾi alladhīna nabadhū al-ḥaqqa warāʾahum wa kānū mina al-muʿtadīna fī kitābin mubīn. Ulāʾika ittabaʿū ahwāʾahum wa aftaw ʿalā alladhī kānū an yanṭiqū ḥīna dhikri ismihi ʿajjala Allāhu farajahu. Kadhālika sawwalat lahum anfusuhum alā innahum mina al-ẓālimīn. Bi-ẓulmihim nāḥa ahlu al-firdawsi al-aʿlā wa al-jannati al-ʿulyā wa akhadha al-dukhānu sukkāna al-arḍi wa al-samāʾ. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man yanṭiqu innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-fardu al-khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Mahdī, the eye of the world has been gladdened by the appearance, in this Revelation, of the One who spoke on Sinai, yet the nations remain behind a thick veil. The Day has appeared, and He who was promised in the Books of God, the Lord of all worlds, has come. He has indeed come with the truth and summoned the people to the most exalted horizon. Among the people are those who denied and turned away, and among them are those who heard and said, “Here I am, O Desire of those who know!” Among them are those whom the might of rulers held back, and those whom the insinuations of religious scholars veiled—scholars who cast the Truth behind them and were numbered among the transgressors in a clear Book. They followed their desires and pronounced judgment against the One at the mention of whose name they used to say, “May God hasten His deliverance.” Thus have their own selves enticed them. Truly, they are among the wrongdoers. Through their oppression, the inhabitants of the most exalted Paradise and the highest Garden have lamented, and smoke has engulfed the dwellers of earth and heaven. To this bears witness the One who declares, “There is no God but Me, the Unique, the All-Aware.”
:::

### 69

::: {.original lang="fa"}
قل یا اهل الخآء و الواو ان استمعوا ندآء مالک الایجاد فی المعاد ثمّ اذکروه فی اللّیالی و الأیّام انّ ربّکم الرّحمن هو السّامع المجیب ایّاکم ان تمنعکم اشارات الظّالمین عن اللّه العزیز الحمید دعوا القوم و ما عندهم متوکّلین علی اللّه المقتدر القدیر سوف یرون المخلصون ما وعدوا به فی کتاب اللّه و المشرکون مقاماتهم فی الجحیم ان افرحوا بذکر قلمی الأعلی انّه یقرّبکم الی اللّه مالک یوم الدّین البهآء المشرق من افق سمآء فضلی علیکم و علی الّذین ما منعهم نعاق النّاعقین الّذین یدّعون الایمان بالبیان و یکفرون بالّذی اتی بسلطان عظیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul yā ahla al-khāʾi wa al-wāwi an istamiʿū nidāʾa Māliki al-ījādi fī al-maʿādi thumma udhkurūhu fī al-layālī wa al-ayyām. Inna rabbakumu al-Raḥmāna huwa al-sāmiʿu al-mujīb. Iyyākum an tamnaʿakum ishārātu al-ẓālimīna ʿani Allāhi al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīd. Daʿū al-qawma wa mā ʿindahum mutawakkilīna ʿalā Allāhi al-muqtadiri al-qadīr. Sawfa yarawna al-mukhliṣūna mā wuʿidū bihi fī kitābi Allāhi wa al-mushrikūna maqāmātihim fī al-jaḥīm. An ifraḥū bi-dhikri qalamī al-aʿlā innahu yuqarribukum ilā Allāhi māliki yawmi al-dīn. Al-bahāʾu al-mushriqu min ufuqi samāʾi faḍlī ʿalaykum wa ʿalā alladhīna mā manaʿahum nuʿāqu al-nāʿiqīna alladhīna yaddaʿūna al-īmāna bi-l-Bayāni wa yakfurūna bi-alladhī atā bi-sulṭānin ʿaẓīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: O people of Khāʾ and Wāw, listen to the call of the Lord of creation on the Day of Return, then remember Him by night and day. Your Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed the All-Hearing, the Responsive. Beware lest the insinuations of the wrongdoers bar you from God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. Leave the people and what they possess, placing your trust in God, the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent. Soon the sincere will behold what they were promised in the Book of God, and those who associate partners with Him will behold their stations in hell. Rejoice in the remembrance of My Most Exalted Pen, for it draws you near to God, the Lord of the Day of Judgment. The glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My grace be upon you and upon those whom the cawing of the criers has not held back—those criers who profess faith in the Bayān and disbelieve in the One who has come with mighty authority. End.
:::

### 70

::: {.original lang="fa"}
للّه الحمد انوار ملکوت بیان الهی اهل آن ارض را احاطه فرمود انشآءاللّه مؤیّد شوند بر اتّحاد و اتّفاق و نصرت امر یعنی ذکر و بیان اینفانی خدمت جناب آقا ملّا مهدی علیه بهآء اللّه و سایر دوستان آن ارض تکبیر و سلام میرساند و از برای هر یک توفیق و تأیید میطلبد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Li-llāh al-ḥamd, anvār-e malakūt-e bayān-e ilāhī ahl-e ān arż rā eḥāṭe farmūd. In shāʾ Allāh moʾayyad shavand bar etteḥād va ettefāq va noṣrat-e amr, yaʿnī dhekr va bayān. Īn fānī khedmat-e Janāb-e Āqā Mullā Mahdī, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, va sāyer-e dūstān-e ān arż takbīr va salām mīresānad va az barā-ye har yek tawfīq va taʾyīd mīṭalabad.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, the lights of the kingdom of divine utterance have encompassed the people of that land. God willing, they will be assisted in unity, concord, and the promotion of the Cause—that is, remembrance and utterance. This transient one conveys greetings of praise and peace to his honor Āqā Mullā Mahdī, upon him be the glory of God, and the other friends of that land, and asks for divine enablement and assistance for each one.
:::

### 71

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا میرزا محمّد (ط‌ب) ابراهیم علیه بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید یک لوح امنع اقدس مخصوص ایشان از سماء مشیّت ربّانی نازل قوله جلّ جلاله و عزّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāre-ye Janāb-e Āqā Mīrzā Muḥammad (Ṭāʾ-Bāʾ) Ibrāhīm, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, marqūm dāshtīd, yek lawḥ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas makhṣūṣ-e īshān az samā-ye mashiyyat-e rabbānī nāzel. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning what you wrote about his honor Āqā Mīrzā Muḥammad (Ṭāʾ-Bāʾ) Ibrāhīm, upon him be the glory of God, a most holy, most inaccessible Tablet was revealed especially for him from the heaven of the divine will. His words—exalted be His glory and mighty His majesty:
:::

### 72

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمه المهیمن علی الأسمآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smihi al-muhaymini ʿalā al-asmāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
In His name, the One who watches over all names.
:::

### 73

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ذکر من لدنّا الی الّذی فاز بأنوار الایمان اذ صعد الفرقان و اتی البیان و بشّر بظهور الرّحمن فی ایّام فیها اخذ الاضطراب سکّان الأرض الّا من شآء اللّه ربّ الأرباب طوبی لنفس ما زلّتها شبهات القوم و لا اشارات کلّ فاجر مرتاب الّذین نبذوا الکتاب و اتّخذوا الأوهام لأنفسهم ارباباً من دون اللّه الا انّهم من اصحاب النّار طوبی للسان اقرّ باللّه و اعترف بما انزله بالحقّ انّه من الأخیار فی کتاب اللّه مولی الأنام قد حضر کتاب من الأمین و فیه ذکرک ذکرناک بذکر اذ ظهر خضعت له الأذکار لعمر اللّه لا یعادل بذکری شیء من الأشیآء یشهد بذلک من عنده امّ الکتاب طوبی لک و للّذین ما نقضوا عهد بارئهم و اقبلوا بوجوه بیضآء الی افق جعله اللّه مشرق الأنوار خذ کتابی بقوّة من عندی و قل لک الحمد یا من باسمک ظهرت الأسرار و نزّلت الآیات و برزت البیّنات و ارتفعت الأعلام و نصبت الرّایات بأن تکتب من قلمک الأعلی لهذا العبد الّذی اقبل الیک یا مولی الوری ما یکون سراجاً له فی کلّ عالم من عوالمک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء لا اله الّا انت القویّ القدیر انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhikrun min ladunnā ilā alladhī fāza bi-anwār al-īmān idh ṣaʿida al-Furqān wa atā al-Bayān wa bashshara bi-ẓuhūr al-Raḥmān fī ayyāmin fīhā akhadha al-iḍṭirābu sukkān al-arḍ illā man shāʾa Allāhu rabbu al-arbāb. Ṭūbā li-nafsin mā zallat-hā shubuhātu al-qawm wa lā ishārātu kulli fājirin murtāb, alladhīna nabadhū al-kitāb wa ittakhadhū al-awhāma li-anfusihim arbāban min dūni Allāh. Alā innahum min aṣḥāb al-nār. Ṭūbā li-lisānin aqarra bi-Allāh wa iʿtarafa bi-mā anzalahu bi-l-ḥaqq, innahu min al-akhyār fī kitābi Allāhi mawlā al-anām. Qad ḥaḍara kitābun min al-Amīn wa fīhi dhikruk. Dhakarnāka bi-dhikrin idh ẓahara khaḍaʿat lahu al-adhkār. La-ʿamru Allāh lā yuʿādalu bi-dhikrī shayʾun min al-ashyāʾ. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man ʿindahu ummu al-kitāb. Ṭūbā laka wa li-lladhīna mā naqaḍū ʿahda bāriʾihim wa aqbalū bi-wujūhin bayḍāʾ ilā ufuqin jaʿalahu Allāhu mashriqa al-anwār. Khudh kitābī bi-quwwatin min ʿindī wa qul laka al-ḥamdu yā man bi-ismika ẓaharat al-asrār wa nuzzilat al-āyāt wa barazat al-bayyināt wa irtafaʿat al-aʿlām wa nuṣibat al-rāyāt bi-an taktuba min qalamika al-aʿlā li-hādhā al-ʿabdi alladhī aqbala ilayka yā mawlā al-warā mā yakūnu sirājan lahu fī kulli ʿālamin min ʿawālimik. Innaka anta al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾ, lā ilāha illā anta al-qawiyyu al-qadīr. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
A remembrance from Us to the one who attained the lights of faith when the Qur’an ascended and the Bayān came and announced the appearance of the All-Merciful, in days when turmoil seized the inhabitants of the earth, except those whom God, the Lord of lords, willed to spare. Blessed is the soul whom neither the people’s doubts nor the insinuations of every wicked doubter caused to stumble—those who cast aside the Book and adopted vain imaginings as lords for themselves instead of God. Indeed, they are among the people of the fire. Blessed is the tongue that acknowledged God and confessed the truth of what He sent down. It is numbered among the righteous in the Book of God, the Lord of humankind. A letter from Amīn has arrived, and in it you are mentioned. We have remembered you with a remembrance before which, when it appeared, all other remembrances bowed. By the life of God, nothing whatsoever can equal My remembrance. He who possesses the Mother Book bears witness to this. Blessed are you and those who have not broken their Creator’s covenant and have turned with radiant faces toward a horizon that God has made the dawning-place of lights. Take hold of My Book with strength from Me and say, “Praise be to You, through whose name mysteries have appeared, verses have been sent down, clear proofs have come forth, standards have been raised, and banners have been unfurled, for writing with Your Most Exalted Pen for this servant who has turned toward You, O Lord of creation, that which will be a lamp for him in every world of Your worlds. You are indeed powerful over whatever You will. There is no god but You, the Strong, the Almighty.” End.
:::

### 74

::: {.original lang="fa"}
للّه الحمد عنایت مقدّس از احصا و ذکر است بر کل لازم در لیالی و ایّام بحمد و ثنای مولی الأسمآء مشغول باشند و بکمال عجز و ابتهال از مالک مآل استدعای قبول نمایند چه که انسان مقامات خود و شأن و ثنای خود را ملاحظه مینماید و همچنین عنایات لاتحصای حقّ را مشاهده میکند متحیّر میشود ولکن از حضرت کریم مأیوس نبوده و نیستیم از حقّ جلّ جلاله میطلبم جناب میرزای مذکور را مؤیّد فرماید و بما ینبغی موفّق دارد
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Li-llāh al-ḥamd, ʿināyat muqaddas az iḥṣā va dhikr ast. Bar kull lāzim dar layālī va ayyām bi-ḥamd va thanā-yi Mawlā al-Asmāʾ mashghūl bāshand va bi-kamāl-i ʿajz va ibtihāl az Mālik-i Maʾāl istidʿā-yi qabūl namāyand, chih kih insān maqāmāt-i khud va shaʾn va thanā-yi khud rā mulāḥiẓih mīnamāyad va hamchunīn ʿināyāt-i lā-tuḥṣā-yi Ḥaqq rā mushāhidih mīkunad, mutaḥayyir mīshavad. Va-lākin az Ḥaḍrat-i Karīm maʾyūs nabūdih va nīstīm. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu mīṭalabam Jināb-i Mīrzā-yi madhkūr rā muʾayyad farmāyad va bi-mā yanbaghī muwaffaq dārad.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, His favor is beyond reckoning and description. All must occupy themselves, by night and day, with praising and extolling the Lord of Names, and with utter humility and supplication beseech the Lord of the final outcome for acceptance. For when a person considers his own stations, standing, and praise, and also beholds the innumerable favors of God, he is bewildered. Yet we have not despaired, nor do we despair, of the Most Generous. I ask God, exalted be His glory, to sustain the aforementioned Mīrzā and enable him to do what is fitting.
:::

### 75

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در این حین نظر بعرض مطلبی قصد مقام اعلی نموده تا آنکه بساحت اقدس فائز شدم اینکلمات عالیات از لسان مالک اسماء و صفات شنیده شد قوله جلّ و عزّ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar īn ḥīn naẓar bi-ʿarḍ-i maṭlabī qaṣd-i maqām-i aʿlā namūdih tā ānkih bi-sāḥat-i aqdas fāʾiz shudam. Īn kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt az lisān-i Mālik-i asmāʾ va ṣifāt shinīdih shud. Qawluhu jalla wa ʿazza.
:::

::: {.translation}
At this time, intending to submit a matter, I set out for the exalted abode and attained the Most Holy Presence. These exalted words were heard from the tongue of the Lord of names and attributes. His words, exalted and mighty is He:
:::

### 76

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا عبد حاضر مدّتهاست عرف محبّت عبدالوهّاب توقّف نموده سبحان‌اللّه او از نفوس مذکورهٴ لدی العرش بوده و عظمت حقّ و ظهورش را برایات آیات و اعلام بیّنات مشاهده نموده چه شده آیا سطوت ظالمین حجاب شده یا شبهات علمای ملحدین بگو یا عبدالوهّاب ربّ وهّاب میفرماید ذرهم فی خوضهم یلعبون اگر صدهزار سنه عمر بتو عطا شود معادله نمینماید بقدمیکه امروز فی سبیل اللّه برداری و یا کلمه‌ئی که للّه بآن تکلّم نمائی بشنو ندای مظلوم آفاق را و بکمال همّت بذکر و ثنای حقّ مشغول باش آنچه ذکر شده و میشود نظر بعنایات حقّ جلّ جلاله است که نسبت بآنجناب بوده قم و قل لک الحمد بما اسمعتنی ندائک و عرّفتنی جمالک اسئلک بأن تجعلنی مشتعلاً بنار حبّک علی شأن ینبغی لظهورک و ایّامک
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿabd-i ḥāḍir, muddat-hāst ʿarf-i maḥabbat-i ʿAbdu’l-Vahhāb tavaqquf namūdih. Subḥān Allāh, ū az nufūs-i madhkūrih-yi ladā al-ʿarsh būdih va ʿaẓamat-i Ḥaqq va ẓuhūrash rā bi-rāyāt-i āyāt va aʿlām-i bayyināt mushāhidih namūdih. Chih shudih? Āyā saṭvat-i ẓālimīn ḥijāb shudih yā shubuhāt-i ʿulamā-yi mulḥidīn? Bigū yā ʿAbdu’l-Vahhāb, Rabb-i Vahhāb mīfarmāyad: dharhum fī khawḍihim yalʿabūn. Agar ṣad-hizār sanih ʿumr bi-tu ʿaṭā shavad muʿādilih namīnamāyad bi-qadamī kih imrūz fī sabīl Allāh bardārī va yā kalimih-ʾī kih li-llāh bi-ān takallum namāʾī. Bishnaw nidā-yi Maẓlūm-i āfāq rā va bi-kamāl-i himmat bi-dhikr va thanā-yi Ḥaqq mashghūl bāsh. Ānchih dhikr shudih va mīshavad naẓar bi-ʿināyāt-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ast kih nisbat bi-ān jināb būdih. Qum wa qul laka al-ḥamdu bi-mā asmaʿtanī nidāʾaka wa ʿarraftanī jamālaka. Asʾaluka bi-an tajʿalanī mushtaʿilan bi-nāri ḥubbika ʿalā shaʾnin yanbaghī li-ẓuhūrika wa ayyāmik.
:::

::: {.translation}
O servant in attendance! For some time the fragrance of ʿAbdu’l-Vahhāb’s love has ceased to waft. Glory be to God! He was among the souls remembered before the Throne and has beheld the greatness of God and His Revelation through the banners of verses and the standards of clear proofs. What has happened? Has the tyranny of the oppressors become a veil, or the doubts of the impious divines? Say: O ʿAbdu’l-Vahhāb! The All-Bestowing Lord says, “Leave them to play in their idle disputation.” If a hundred thousand years of life were granted to you, they would not equal a step you take today in the path of God, or a word you utter for His sake. Hear the call of the Wronged One of the world, and devote yourself with the utmost resolve to remembering and praising God. Whatever has been and is being said is in view of the favors that God, exalted be His glory, has bestowed upon you. Arise and say, “Praise be to You for causing me to hear Your call and recognize Your beauty. I ask You to set me ablaze with the fire of Your love in a manner befitting Your Revelation and Your days.”
:::

### 77

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بیقین بدان احتیاط و حزم بر حیات نیفزاید و استقامت و قیام از حیات نکاهد للّه بایست و للّه بگو ولکن بحکمت و بیان در کلّ احوال ناظر باش قدر مقام را بدان و چون جان حفظش نما انّه هو الحافظ النّاصر المعین الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-yaqīn bidān iḥtiyāṭ va ḥazm bar ḥayāt nayafzāyad va istiqāmat va qiyām az ḥayāt nakāhad. Li-llāh bi-īst va li-llāh bigū, va-lākin bi-ḥikmat va bayān dar kull-i aḥvāl nāẓir bāsh. Qadr-i maqām rā bidān va chūn jān ḥifẓash namā. Innahu huwa al-ḥāfiẓu al-nāṣiru al-muʿīn. Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Know with certainty that caution and prudence do not prolong life, nor do steadfastness and rising to act shorten it. Stand up for God and speak for God, but in all circumstances give heed to wisdom and utterance. Appreciate the worth of this station and guard it as your own life. He is indeed the Preserver, the Helper, the Sustainer. Praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds. End.
:::

### 78

::: {.original lang="fa"}
فی‌الحقیقه چندی است خبری از ایشان بساحت اقدس نیامده نه رایحه‌ئی مرور نموده و نه عرفی متضوّع چون از قبل در سنین متوالیه در سجن مذکور بودند از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل که ایشان را مؤیّد فرماید تأییدیکه عرف استقامت از او استشمام گردد انّه هو الغفور الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Fī al-ḥaqīqih chandī ast khabarī az īshān bi-sāḥat-i aqdas nayāmadih, nah rāyiḥih-ʾī murūr namūdih va nah ʿarfī mutaḍavviʿ. Chūn az qabl dar sinīn-i mutavāliyih dar sijn madhkūr būdand, az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu sāʾil kih īshān rā muʾayyad farmāyad, taʾyīdī kih ʿarf-i istiqāmat az ū istishmām gardad. Innahu huwa al-ghafūru al-karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
Indeed, for some time no news of him has reached the Most Holy Presence; no fragrance has passed by, nor has any sweet scent spread abroad. Since in previous years he was mentioned in the Prison year after year, I beseech God, exalted be His glory, to sustain him with such assistance that the fragrance of steadfastness may be perceived from him. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Generous.
:::

### 79

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حسب الأمر اگر اقتضا نمود آنچه از سماء مشیّت نازل القا شود فرمودند انّا نحبّ ان نجد منه ما وجدناه من قبل انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥasb al-amr agar iqtiḍā namūd ānchih az samāʾ-i mashiyyat nāzil ilqā shavad. Farmūdand: innā nuḥibbu an najida minhu mā wajadnāhu min qabl. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In accordance with the command, if circumstances warrant, what has descended from the heaven of the divine will is to be conveyed. He said, “We wish to find in him what We found before.” End.
:::

### 80

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ذکر جناب آقا میرزا عبداللّه علیه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] \[ی\] نموده بودند در ساحت امنع اقدس عرض شد هذا ما نزّل له من سمآء عنایة ربّنا المجیب قوله بهر بحر بیانه و احاطت انوار شمس فضله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhikr-i Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā ʿAbdu’llāh ʿalayhi 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\] \[y\] namūdih būdand. Dar sāḥat-i amnaʿ-i aqdas ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā nuzzila lahu min samāʾi ʿināyati rabbinā al-mujīb. Qawluhu bahara baḥru bayānihi wa aḥāṭat anwāru shamsi faḍlih.
:::

::: {.translation}
You had mentioned his honor Āqā Mīrzā ʿAbdu’llāh, upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\] \[Y\]. This was submitted in the Most Inaccessible, Most Holy Presence. This is what was sent down for him from the heaven of the favor of our Lord, the Answerer. His words—dazzling is the ocean of His utterance, and all-encompassing are the lights of the sun of His grace:
:::

### 81

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هو المقتدر علی من فی الأرض و السّمآء یا عبداللّه ذکرت لدی المظلوم بوده و عریضه‌ات چندی قبل بساحت اقدس حاضر و باصغا فائز للّه الحمد بافق اعلی ناظری و بمحبّت حقّ جلّ جلاله مزیّن آنچه مذکور نمودی لدی العرش معلوم از حقّ جلّ جلاله میطلبیم ترا مؤیّد فرماید بر استقامت قسم بآفتاب افق بیان امروز استقامت از اعظم صفاتست لدی الوجه طوبی لنفس فازت بها نفوس مذکورهٴ در عریضه هر یک بذکر حقّ جلّ جلاله فائز و نسئل اللّه بأن یفتح علی وجهک باب البرکة انّه هو المقتدر علی ما یشآء و فی قبضته زمام من فی السّموات و الأرضین البهآء علیک من لدنّا و علی الّذین فازوا بهذا الذّکر الحکیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-muqtadiru ʿalā man fī al-arḍi wa al-samāʾ. Yā ʿAbdu’llāh, dhikrat ladā al-Maẓlūm būdih va ʿarīḍih-at chandī qabl bi-sāḥat-i aqdas ḥāḍir va bi-iṣghā fāʾiz. Li-llāh al-ḥamd bi-ufuq-i aʿlā nāẓirī va bi-maḥabbat-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu muzayyan. Ānchih madhkūr namūdī ladā al-ʿarsh maʿlūm. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu mīṭalabīm tu-rā muʾayyad farmāyad bar istiqāmat. Qasam bi-āftāb-i ufuq-i bayān, imrūz istiqāmat az aʿẓam-i ṣifāt ast ladā al-wajh. Ṭūbā li-nafsin fāzat bihā. Nufūs-i madhkūrih-yi dar ʿarīḍih har yik bi-dhikr-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu fāʾiz. Wa nasʾalu Allāha bi-an yaftaḥa ʿalā wajhika bāba al-barakah. Innahu huwa al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā yashāʾ wa fī qabḍatihi zimāmu man fī al-samāwāti wa al-araḍīn. Al-bahāʾu ʿalayka min ladunnā wa ʿalā alladhīna fāzū bi-hādhā al-dhikri al-ḥakīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the All-Powerful over all who are on earth and in heaven. O ʿAbdu’llāh! You have been remembered before the Wronged One, and your letter reached the Most Holy Presence some time ago and was heard. Praise be to God, you look toward the Most Exalted Horizon and are adorned with the love of God, exalted be His glory. What you mentioned is known before the Throne. We ask God, exalted be His glory, to sustain you in steadfastness. By the sun of the horizon of utterance, today steadfastness is among the greatest attributes in His presence. Blessed is the soul that has attained it. Each of the souls mentioned in your letter has been favored with the remembrance of God, exalted be His glory. We ask God to open the door of blessing before your face. He indeed has power over whatever He wills, and in His grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and the earths. Glory rest upon you from Us, and upon those who have attained this wise remembrance. End.
:::

### 82

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ایشان و اخوی ایشان که در شاهرود بودند و همچنین نفوس اخری مکرّر بعنایت حقّ فائز شدند اینفانی خدمت هر یک تکبیر و سلام میرساند و از برای کل توفیق میطلبد اینکه در بارهٴ حقوق مرقوم داشتند در ساحت امنع اقدس عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان الفضل فی الجواب قوله جلّ جلاله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īshān va akhavī-yi īshān kih dar Shāhrūd būdand va hamchunīn nufūs-i ukhrā mukarrar bi-ʿināyat-i Ḥaqq fāʾiz shudand. Īn fānī khidmat-i har yik takbīr va salām mīrasānad va az barā-yi kull tawfīq mīṭalabad. Īnkih dar bārih-yi Ḥuqūq marqūm dāshtand dar sāḥat-i amnaʿ-i aqdas ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisānu al-faḍli fī al-jawāb. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
He and his brother, who were in Shāhrūd, and likewise other souls, have repeatedly been favored with God’s grace. This mortal conveys greetings of “God is Most Great” and peace to each of them and prays for divine assistance for all. What you wrote concerning the Right of God was submitted in the Most Inaccessible, Most Holy Presence. This is what the Tongue of Grace spoke in reply. His words, exalted be His glory:
:::

### 83

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا امین سالها ما ذکر حقوق ننمودیم مع آنکه اینفقره سبب حفظ و علّت برکت الهی و آثار دیگر بوده چه مقدار از نفوس که خود از \[مال\] خود بحضور فرستادند و چه آوردند اخذ ننمودیم و واگذاشتیم چه که لازم نبود حال آنجناب بر امورات این ارض مطّلعند و همچنین اسباب لازم است از برای اعلاء کلمه ولکن نباید نفسی از کسی طلب نماید اگر نفسی فائز شد بادای حقوق الهی اخذ شود والّا فلا در جمیع احوال باید اولیای حقّ مراقب اعزاز امر باشند و تا حال امر نشد احدی مطالبه نماید انّه غنیّ عمّا کان و ما یکون انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Amīn, sāl-hā mā dhikr-i Ḥuqūq nanamūdīm, maʿa ānkih īn fiqrih sabab-i ḥifẓ va ʿillat-i barakat-i ilāhī va āthār-i dīgar būdih. Chih miqdār az nufūs kih khud az \[māl\]-i khud bi-ḥuḍūr firistādand va chih āvardand akhdh nanamūdīm va vāgudhāshtīm, chih kih lāzim nabūd. Ḥāl ān jināb bar umūrāt-i īn arḍ muṭṭaliʿand va hamchunīn asbāb lāzim ast az barā-yi iʿlā-yi kalimih, va-lākin nabāyad nafsī az kasī ṭalab namāyad. Agar nafsī fāʾiz shud bi-adā-yi Ḥuqūq-i ilāhī akhdh shavad, va-illā fa-lā. Dar jamīʿ-i aḥvāl bāyad awliyā-yi Ḥaqq murāqib-i iʿzāz-i Amr bāshand va tā ḥāl amr nashud aḥadī muṭālibih namāyad. Innahu ghaniyyun ʿammā kāna wa mā yakūn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Amīn! For years We made no mention of the Right of God, although it has been a means of protection, a cause of divine blessing, and a source of other effects. How many souls sent offerings from their own \[possessions\] into Our presence or brought them themselves, yet We did not accept them and left them untouched, for there was no need. Now you are aware of affairs in this land, and means are also needed for exalting the Word. Nevertheless, no one should ask anyone for payment. If a soul attains the privilege of paying the Right of God, it should be accepted; otherwise, not. In all circumstances the friends of God must be mindful of upholding the honor of the Cause. Until now, no command has been given for anyone to demand payment. He is independent of all that has been and all that will be. End.
:::

### 84

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه مرقوم داشتند بعضی اخذ مینمایند و صرف میکنند بادّعای اذن ابداً چنین اذنی صادر نشده از برای احدی باید اولیا مخصوص آنمحبوب در جمیع احوال باسبابیکه سبب ارتفاع کلمه است ناظر باشند ایّام فانیست باید دوستان بعدل و انصاف و صدق و صفا عامل باشند و بآنچه سبب اعزاز امر است متمسّک مکرّر ذکر شد تا آنمحبوب بدانند که چنین امری صادر نشده
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnkih marqūm dāshtand baʿḍī akhdh mīnamāyand va ṣarf mīkunand bi-iddiʿā-yi idhn, abadan chunīn idhnī ṣādir nashudih az barā-yi aḥadī. Bāyad awliyā makhṣūṣ ān maḥbūb dar jamīʿ-i aḥvāl bi-asbābī kih sabab-i irtifāʿ-i kalimih ast nāẓir bāshand. Ayyām fānī-st. Bāyad dūstān bi-ʿadl va inṣāf va ṣidq va ṣafā ʿāmil bāshand va bi-ānchih sabab-i iʿzāz-i Amr ast mutamassik. Mukarrar dhikr shud tā ān maḥbūb bidānand kih chunīn amrī ṣādir nashudih.
:::

::: {.translation}
As for what you wrote, that some receive and spend it claiming permission, no such permission has ever been issued to anyone. The friends, and especially you, dear friend, must in all circumstances look to the means that exalt the Word. These days are fleeting. The friends must act with justice, fairness, truthfulness, and purity, and hold fast to whatever upholds the honor of the Cause. This has been stated repeatedly so that you, dear friend, may know that no such command has been issued.
:::

### 85

::: {.original lang="fa"}
حینیکه محبوب فؤاد جناب حاجی میرزا ح‌ی ع‌ل و جناب آقا میرزا حسین علیهما بهآء اللّه و عنایته بحضور فائز بودند لسان عظمت ذکر شما را فرمود للّه الحمد بعنایت فائزید و بکلمهٴ رضا مزیّن هنیئاً لجنابکم و مریئاً لجنابکم این حین که بتحریر این ورقه مشغول بودم بحضور فائز مقصود عالمیان باینکلمهٴ مبارکه ناطق قوله جلّ جلاله و احاط فضله یا عبد حاضر انّا نحبّ ان نذکر الّذین شربوا رحیق الاستقامة هناک فضلاً من عندنا و انا الذّاکر المشفق الکریم نذکرهم و نستر اسمائهم حکمة من لدنّا و انا الآمر الحکیم انّا ذکرنا الصّاد بذکر تضوّع منه عرف عنایتی فی ملکوتی الممتنع المنیع و نذکره فی هذا الحین بذکر جمیل البهآء اللّائح من افق عنایتی علی الّذین ما ذکرنا اسمائهم و علی الّذین شربوا رحیقی المختوم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ḥīnī kih maḥbūb-i fuʾād Jināb-i Ḥājī Mīrzā Ḥ-Y ʿ-L va Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Ḥusayn ʿalayhimā bahāʾu Allāhi wa ʿināyatuhu bi-ḥuḍūr fāʾiz būdand lisān-i ʿaẓamat dhikr-i shumā rā farmūd. Li-llāh al-ḥamd bi-ʿināyat fāʾizīd va bi-kalimih-yi riḍā muzayyan. Hanīʾan li-jinābikum wa marīʾan li-jinābikum. Īn ḥīn kih bi-taḥrīr-i īn varaqih mashghūl būdam bi-ḥuḍūr fāʾiz, Maqṣūd-i ʿālamiyān bi-īn kalimih-yi mubārakih nāṭiq. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa aḥāṭa faḍluhu: yā ʿabd-i ḥāḍir, innā nuḥibbu an nadhkura alladhīna sharibū raḥīqa al-istiqāmati hunāka faḍlan min ʿindinā wa anā al-dhākiru al-mushfiqu al-karīm. Nadhkuruhum wa nasturu asmāʾahum ḥikmatan min ladunnā wa anā al-āmiru al-ḥakīm. Innā dhakarnā al-Ṣāda bi-dhikrin taḍawwaʿa minhu ʿarfu ʿināyatī fī malakūtī al-mumtaniʿi al-manīʿ, wa nadhkuruhu fī hādhā al-ḥīni bi-dhikrin jamīl. Al-bahāʾu al-lāʾiḥu min ufuqi ʿināyatī ʿalā alladhīna mā dhakarnā asmāʾahum wa ʿalā alladhīna sharibū raḥīqī al-makhtūm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
When the beloved of my heart, his honor Ḥājī Mīrzā Ḥ-Y ʿ-L, and his honor Āqā Mīrzā Ḥusayn, upon them both be the glory of God and His favor, were in His presence, the Tongue of Grandeur mentioned you. Praise be to God, you have attained His favor and are adorned with the word of His good pleasure. May it bring you joy and delight! Just now, while I was engaged in writing this page, I attained His presence, and the Desire of all the worlds spoke these blessed words. His words, exalted be His glory and all-encompassing His grace: “O servant in attendance! We wish to remember those who have drunk the choice wine of steadfastness in that place, as a grace from Us. I am the One who remembers, the Compassionate, the All-Generous. We remember them and conceal their names out of wisdom on Our part. I am the Ordainer, the All-Wise. We have remembered Ṣād with a remembrance from which the fragrance of My favor has spread throughout My inaccessible, impregnable Kingdom, and We remember him at this time with a beautiful remembrance. May the glory shining from the horizon of My favor rest upon those whose names We have not mentioned, and upon those who have drunk My sealed wine.” End.
:::

### 86

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هر ذرّه‌ئی از ذرّات کائنات شهادت بر فضل و رحمت و شفقت و عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله داده و میدهد از او میطلبیم اینفانی و اولیای خود را برضایش مزیّن و بر استقامت بر امرش موفّق دارد اینست مقامیکه اولیا و اصفیاء قبل و بعد از حقّ جلّ جلاله مسئلت نموده‌اند اینفانی بکمال عجز میطلبد از برای کل آنچه را که از برای خود میطلبد و از برای دوستان مسئلت مینماید آنچه که خود را قابل آن نمیداند امواج بحر رحمت الهی بشأنی ظاهر که گویا شجرهٴ یأس مقطوع و نهالهای رجا از جمیع جهات مرتفع تعالی تعالی کرمه و فضله و سلطانه و عزّه و ذکره التّکبیر و البهآء و الثّنآء علی جنابکم و علی الّذین سمعوا و اجابوا ربّهم النّاطق العلیم الحکیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Har dharrih-ʾī az dharrāt-i kāʾināt shahādat bar faḍl va raḥmat va shafaqat va ʿināyat-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu dādih va mīdahad. Az ū mīṭalabīm īn fānī va awliyā-yi khud rā bi-riḍāyash muzayyan va bar istiqāmat bar Amrash muwaffaq dārad. Īn ast maqāmī kih awliyā va aṣfiyā-yi qabl va baʿd az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu masʾalat namūdih-and. Īn fānī bi-kamāl-i ʿajz mīṭalabad az barā-yi kull ānchih rā kih az barā-yi khud mīṭalabad va az barā-yi dūstān masʾalat mīnamāyad ānchih kih khud rā qābil-i ān namīdānad. Amvāj-i baḥr-i raḥmat-i ilāhī bi-shaʾnī ẓāhir kih gūyā shajarih-yi yaʾs maqṭūʿ va nahāl-hā-yi rajā az jamīʿ-i jihāt murtafiʿ. Taʿālā taʿālā karamuhu wa faḍluhu wa sulṭānuhu wa ʿizzuhu wa dhikruhu. Al-takbīru wa al-bahāʾu wa al-thanāʾu ʿalā jinābikum wa ʿalā alladhīna samiʿū wa ajābū rabbahum al-nāṭiqa al-ʿalīma al-ḥakīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
Every atom of creation has borne and continues to bear witness to the grace, mercy, compassion, and favor of God, exalted be His glory. We ask Him to adorn this mortal and His friends with His good pleasure and enable them to remain steadfast in His Cause. This is the station that His friends and chosen ones, both former and latter, have sought from God, exalted be His glory. This mortal, in utter humility, asks for everyone what he asks for himself, and beseeches for the friends what he does not consider himself worthy of receiving. The waves of the ocean of divine mercy are so manifest that it is as though the tree of despair has been cut down and the saplings of hope have risen on every side. Exalted, exalted are His generosity, His grace, His sovereignty, His might, and His remembrance. Greetings of “God is Most Great,” glory, and praise rest upon you and upon those who have heard and answered their Lord, the Speaker, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
:::

### 87

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسم ربّنا الأقدس الأعظم العلیّ الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smi rabbinā al-aqdasi al-aʿẓami al-ʿaliyyi al-abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of our Lord, the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most High, the All-Glorious.
:::

### 88

::: {.original lang="ar"}
شهد اللّه انّه لا اله الّا هو له العزّة و الاقتدار و له القوّة و الاختیار یرفع من یشآء و یضع الآخرین و هو المقتدر العلیم الحکیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Shahida Allāhu annahu lā ilāha illā huwa, lahu al-ʿizzatu wa al-iqtidār wa lahu al-quwwatu wa al-ikhtiyār. Yarfaʿu man yashāʾu wa yaḍaʿu al-ākharīn wa huwa al-muqtadiru al-ʿalīmu al-ḥakīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
God bears witness that there is no god but Him. His are might and dominion, and His are strength and the power to choose. He exalts whomever He wills and abases others. He is the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
:::

### 89

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و بعد نامهٴ دیگر آنمحبوب که از قبل ارسال داشته بودند نظر بکثرت اشغال و امور جواب تأخیر افتاد از حقّ جلّ جلاله میطلبم خادم را مؤیّد فرماید بر تدارک آنچه از او فوت شده نامه رسید و باب وصل گشود و نفحهٴ قرب مرور نمود للّه الحمد امطار ذکر و بیان از قلم و لسان اولیائش جاریست فی‌الحقیقه ذکر و بیان مفتاحند از برای باب قرب و وصال
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va baʿd, nāme-ye dīgar-e ān maḥbūb ke az qabl ersāl dāshte būdand, naẓar be-kethrat-e ashghāl va omūr javāb taʾkhīr oftād. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu mī-ṭalabam khādem rā moʾayyad farmāyad bar tadārok-e ānche az ū fawt shode. Nāme rasīd va bāb-e vaṣl goshūd va nafḥe-ye qorb morūr namūd. Li-llāhi al-ḥamd, amṭār-e dhekr va bayān az qalam va lesān-e awliyāyash jārīst. Fī al-ḥaqīqe dhekr va bayān meftāḥand az barā-ye bāb-e qorb va veṣāl.
:::

::: {.translation}
Furthermore, the reply to the other letter that beloved friend had sent earlier was delayed because of the press of occupations and affairs. I ask God, exalted be His glory, to assist this servant in making up for what he has missed. The letter arrived, opened the door of reunion, and brought a passing breeze of nearness. Praise be to God, showers of remembrance and utterance flow from the pens and tongues of His loved ones. Indeed, remembrance and utterance are keys to the door of nearness and reunion.
:::

### 90

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ذکر جناب آقا محمّد رضا (محمّدآباد) علیه بهآء اللّه را نموده بودند و همچنین مراتب شوق و اشتیاق و اشتعال ایشانرا در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد و این آیات باهرات مخصوص ایشان از سماء عنایت رحمن نازل قوله عزّ بیانه و قدس مقامه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhekr-e Janāb-e Āqā Moḥammad Reḍā (Moḥammadābād), ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, rā namūde būdand va hamchenīn marāteb-e shawq va eshtiyāq va eshteʿāl-e īshān rā. Dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā ʿarḍ shod va īn āyāt-e bāherāt makhṣūṣ-e īshān az samā-ye ʿenāyat-e Raḥmān nāzel. Qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu wa quddisa maqāmuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
You had mentioned Áqá Muḥammad Riḍá (Muḥammadábád), upon him be the glory of God, as well as the degree of his longing, ardor, and fervor. This was presented in the most exalted, most holy, most inaccessible court, and these resplendent verses were revealed especially for him from the heaven of the All-Merciful’s favor. His words, exalted be His utterance and sanctified His station:
:::

### 91

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمه المهیمن علی من فی الأرض و السّمآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismihi al-Muhaymin ʿalā man fī al-arḍ wa al-samāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
In His name, the Guardian over all who are on earth and in heaven.
:::

### 92

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محمّد قبل رضا قل لک الحمد یا الهی بما فتحت علی وجوه اولیائک باب اللّقآء و لک الثّنآء یا مولی الأسمآء بما فتحت بمقالید البیان ابواب العرفان و لک البهآء یا فاطر السّمآء بما نوّرت العالم بأنوار اسمک الأعظم و لک الجلال یا مطلع الجمال بما هدیت احبّائک الی سوآء الصّراط و لک الفضل یا مشرق العدل بما دعوت العباد الی افقک الأعلی فی المبدء و المعاد و لک النّور یا مکلّم الطّور بما عرّفت اهل المعانی افق ظهورک و لک الظّهور یا معطی الأرواح بما جعلتنا منجذبین بآیاتک و مقبلین الی افقک و مشتعلین بنار حبّک و طائرین فی هوآء قربک و ناطقین بثنائک الجمیل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Muḥammad qabla Riḍā, qul: Laka al-ḥamd yā Ilāhī bi-mā fataḥta ʿalā wujūhi awliyāʾika bāba al-liqāʾ, wa laka al-thanāʾ yā Mawlā al-asmāʾ bi-mā fataḥta bi-maqālīdi al-bayān abwāba al-ʿirfān, wa laka al-bahāʾ yā Fāṭira al-samāʾ bi-mā nawwarta al-ʿālama bi-anwāri ismika al-Aʿẓam, wa laka al-jalāl yā Maṭliʿa al-jamāl bi-mā hadayta aḥibbāʾaka ilā sawāʾi al-ṣirāṭ, wa laka al-faḍl yā Mashriqa al-ʿadl bi-mā daʿawta al-ʿibāda ilā ufuqika al-aʿlā fī al-mabdaʾ wa al-maʿād, wa laka al-nūr yā Mukallima al-Ṭūr bi-mā ʿarrafta ahla al-maʿānī ufuqa ẓuhūrika, wa laka al-ẓuhūr yā Muʿṭiya al-arwāḥ bi-mā jaʿaltanā munjadhibīna bi-āyātika wa muqbilīna ilā ufuqika wa mushtaʿilīna bi-nāri ḥubbika wa ṭāʾirīna fī hawāʾi qurbika wa nāṭiqīna bi-thanāʾika al-jamīl.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muḥammad before Riḍá, say: Praise be to You, my God, for opening before the faces of Your loved ones the door of meeting You. Adoration be to You, Lord of Names, for opening the doors of recognition with the keys of utterance. Glory be to You, Creator of heaven, for illuminating the world with the lights of Your Most Great Name. Majesty be to You, Dawning-Place of Beauty, for guiding Your loved ones to the straight path. Bounty be to You, Dayspring of Justice, for summoning Your servants to Your most exalted horizon in the beginning and the return. Light be to You, the One who spoke on Sinai, for making known to the people of inner meaning the horizon of Your revelation. Manifestation be to You, Giver of spirits, for making us enraptured by Your verses, turned toward Your horizon, aflame with the fire of Your love, soaring in the air of Your nearness, and voicing Your beautiful praise.
:::

### 93

::: {.original lang="fa"}
قل یا الهی و سیّدی و معبودی و مقصودی تسمع ما تنطق به السن الکائنات و تری ما تعمل به الممکنات اسئلک بلآلئ عمّان علمک و برحمتک الّتی سبقت خلقک و عبادک و بسرّک المکنون و اسمک المخزون الّذی اظهر نفسه فی ناسوت الانشآء و باستوائه علی العرش بین الوری بأن تنزل من سمآء جودک امطار رحمتک ثمّ احفظ اولیائک من شرّ اعدائک اسئلک یا مولی العالم و مقصود الأمم باسمک الأعظم بأن تنصر احبّائک بقوّتک و قدرتک و جنود غیبک کما نصرتهم من قبل انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک ازمّة من فی الأرض و السّمآء
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qul: Yā Ilāhī wa Sayyidī wa Maʿbūdī wa Maqṣūdī, tasmaʿu mā tanṭiqu bihi alsunu al-kāʾināt wa tarā mā taʿmalu bihi al-mumkināt. Asʾaluka bi-laʾāliʾi ʿummāni ʿilmika wa bi-raḥmatika allatī sabaqat khalqaka wa ʿibādaka wa bi-sirrika al-maknūn wa ismika al-makhzūn alladhī aẓhara nafsahu fī nāsūti al-inshāʾ wa bi-istiwāʾihi ʿalā al-ʿarsh bayna al-warā bi-an tunzila min samāʾi jūdika amṭāra raḥmatika thumma iḥfaẓ awliyāʾaka min sharri aʿdāʾika. Asʾaluka yā Mawlā al-ʿālam wa Maqṣūda al-umam bi-ismika al-Aʿẓam bi-an tanṣura aḥibbāʾaka bi-quwwatika wa qudratika wa junūdi ghaybika ka-mā naṣartahum min qabl. Innaka anta al-Muqtadir ʿalā mā tashāʾ wa fī qabḍatika azimmatu man fī al-arḍ wa al-samāʾ.
:::

::: {.translation}
Say: My God, my Master, the One I worship and seek! You hear what the tongues of all beings utter and see what all created things do. I ask You, by the pearls of the ocean of Your knowledge, by Your mercy that preceded Your creation and Your servants, by Your hidden mystery and Your treasured Name, who manifested Himself in the human realm of creation, and by His establishment upon the throne among humanity, to send down the rains of Your mercy from the heaven of Your generosity. Then protect Your loved ones from the malice of Your enemies. I ask You, Lord of the world and Desire of the nations, by Your Most Great Name, to aid Your loved ones with Your strength, Your power, and Your unseen hosts, as You aided them before. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and in Your grasp are the reins of all who are on earth and in heaven.
:::

### 94

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ای ربّ تری عبدک هذا شهد بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک و بما جری من قلمک الأعلی فی ملکوت الانشآء و یشهد بما نطق به لسانک یا مالک الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء ای ربّ ترانی متمسّکاً بحبلک و متشبّثاً بذیل عنایتک و راجیاً ما عندک اسئلک ان لا تخیّبنی بجودک و فضلک و الطافک لا اله الّا انت القویّ القادر السّامع المجیب انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ay Rabb, tarā ʿabdaka hādhā shahida bi-waḥdāniyyatika wa fardāniyyatika wa bi-mā jarā min qalamika al-aʿlā fī malakūti al-inshāʾ, wa yashhadu bi-mā naṭaqa bihi lisānuka yā Mālika al-asmāʾ wa Fāṭira al-samāʾ. Ay Rabb, tarānī mutamassikan bi-ḥablika wa mutashabbithan bi-dhayli ʿināyatika wa rājiyan mā ʿindaka. Asʾaluka an lā tukhayyibanī bi-jūdika wa faḍlika wa alṭāfika. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Qawiyy al-Qādir al-Sāmiʿ al-Mujīb. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Lord, You see this servant of Yours bearing witness to Your oneness and uniqueness and to what has flowed from Your Most Exalted Pen in the kingdom of creation. He also bears witness to what Your tongue has spoken, Lord of Names and Creator of heaven. O Lord, You see me holding fast to Your cord, clinging to the hem of Your loving care, and hoping for what is with You. I ask You, by Your generosity, Your bounty, and Your gracious favors, not to disappoint me. There is no god but You, the Strong, the Powerful, the Hearer, the Answerer. End of quotation.
:::

### 95

::: {.original lang="fa"}
این آیات که هر حرفی از آن باب رحمتی است از برای خلق مخصوص جناب مذکور نازل انشآءاللّه بآن فائز شوند عرفش عالم بیان را تجدید نماید و اشجار وجود را تازه کند از قبل هم ایشان بذکر مقصودنا و مقصودکم و مقصود من فی الأرض و السّمآء فائز شده‌اند از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل و آمل که ایشانرا در جمیع احوال مؤیّد فرماید انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn āyāt ke har ḥarfī az ān bāb-e raḥmatī ast az barā-ye khalq, makhṣūṣ-e Janāb-e madhkūr nāzel. In shāʾ Allāh be-ān fāʾez shavand. ʿArfash ʿālam-e bayān rā tajdīd namāyad va ashjār-e vojūd rā tāze konad. Az qabl ham īshān be-dhekr-e Maqṣūdinā wa Maqṣūdikum wa Maqṣūdi man fī al-arḍ wa al-samāʾ fāʾez shode-and. Az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu sāʾel va āmel ke īshān rā dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl moʾayyad farmāyad. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
These verses, every letter of which is a door of mercy for creation, were revealed especially for the gentleman mentioned. God willing, he will receive them. Their fragrance renews the world of utterance and refreshes the trees of existence. Previously, too, he was favored with mention by the One who is our Desire, your Desire, and the Desire of all who are on earth and in heaven. I ask and hope that God, exalted be His glory, will assist him in every circumstance. He indeed has power over all things.
:::

### 96

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و همچنین ذکر جناب حاجی محمّد طاهر علیه بهآء اللّه را فرمودند عرض فانی آنکه هر نفسی الیوم اقلّ من آن بوجه مقصود عالمیان توجّه نمود ذکرش از لسان عظمت ظاهر فضل بمقام و مرتبه‌ایست که عالم از احصائش عاجز و از ذکرش قاصر صدهزار طوبی از برای نفسیکه بذکر الهی در یومش فائز شد اینست آن کنزیکه در ظلّ عرش مکنون و محفوظ است از برای صاحبش اهل ارض غافلند قسم بمحبوب عالم اگر شاعر شوند از برای یکحرف که از سماء مشیّت مقصود نازل شود جان نثار نمایند هذا حقّ لا ریب فیه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va hamchenīn dhekr-e Janāb-e Ḥājī Moḥammad Ṭāher, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, rā farmūdand. ʿArḍ-e fānī ānke har nafsī al-yawm aqalla min ān be-vajh-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān tavajjoh namūd, dhekrash az lesān-e ʿaẓamat ẓāher. Faḍl be-maqām va martabe-īst ke ʿālam az eḥṣāyash ʿājez va az dhekrash qāṣer. Ṣad hezār ṭūbā az barā-ye nafsī ke be-dhekr-e elāhī dar yawmash fāʾez shod. Īnast ān kanzī ke dar ẓell-e ʿarsh maknūn va maḥfūẓ ast az barā-ye ṣāḥebash. Ahl-e arḍ ghāfeland. Qasam be-Maḥbūb-e ʿālam, agar shāʿer shavand az barā-ye yek ḥarf ke az samā-ye mashiyyat-e Maqṣūd nāzel shavad jān nethār namāyand. Hādhā ḥaqqun lā rayba fīh.
:::

::: {.translation}
You also mentioned Ḥájí Muḥammad Ṭáhir, upon him be the glory of God. This humble one submits that whoever has turned today, for less than an instant, toward the face of the Desire of all the worlds has been mentioned by the Tongue of Grandeur. Such is the measure and degree of His bounty that the world is powerless to reckon it and unable to describe it. A hundred thousand blessings upon the soul who has been favored with God’s remembrance in His Day! This is the treasure concealed and preserved beneath the shadow of the Throne for its owner. The people of the earth are heedless. I swear by the Beloved of the world, if they were to perceive it, they would offer their lives for a single letter sent down from the heaven of the will of the Desired One. This is a truth beyond all doubt.
:::

### 97

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینفقره هم وقتی از اوقات تلقاء وجه عرض شد و باصغا فائز گشت هذا ما نزّل له من ملکوت ربّنا الرّحمن قوله تبارک و تعالی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn feqre ham vaqtī az awqāt telqā-ye vajh ʿarḍ shod va be-eṣghā fāʾez gasht. Hādhā mā nuzzila lahu min malakūti Rabbinā al-Raḥmān. Qawluhu tabāraka wa taʿālā:
:::

::: {.translation}
This matter, too, was presented in His presence on one occasion and was graciously heard. This is what was sent down for him from the kingdom of our Lord, the All-Merciful. His words, blessed and exalted is He:
:::

### 98

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی السّمیع المجیب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismī al-Samīʿ al-Mujīb.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the All-Hearing, the Answerer.
:::

### 99

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا محمّد قبل طاهر یذکرک فی هذا اللّیل من طاف حوله الملأ الأعلی و اهل الفردوس و الملائکة المقرّبون ان اشکر اللّه ثمّ اذکره فی اللّیالی و الأیّام انّه یسمع و یری و هو الحقّ علّام الغیوب نوصیک و الّذین آمنوا بالأمانة و الوفآء و بما یرتفع به کلمة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Muḥammad qabla Ṭāhir, yadhkuruka fī hādhā al-layl man ṭāfa ḥawlahu al-malaʾu al-aʿlā wa ahlu al-Firdaws wa al-malāʾikatu al-muqarrabūn. An ishkur Allāh thumma udhkurhu fī al-layālī wa al-ayyām. Innahu yasmaʿu wa yarā wa huwa al-Ḥaqq ʿAllāmu al-ghuyūb. Nūṣīka wa alladhīna āmanū bi-al-amānati wa al-wafāʾ wa bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi kalimatu Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Muḥammad before Ṭáhir, tonight you are remembered by Him around whom circle the Concourse on high, the people of Paradise, and the angels brought near. Give thanks to God, then remember Him by night and day. He indeed hears and sees, and He is the Truth, the Knower of all unseen things. We exhort you and those who have believed to be trustworthy and faithful, and to do whatever exalts the Word of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.
:::

### 100

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اذا فزت بآیاتی و وجدت عرف بیانی قل سبحانک یا ایّها المظلوم المسجون اشهد انّک اخترت البلآء لنجاة من فی ملکوت الانشآء و سکنت فی السّجن لخلاص من علی الأرض لا اله الّا انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام الأسمآء انّک انت العلیم الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Idhā fuzta bi-āyātī wa wajadta ʿarfa bayānī qul: Subḥānaka yā ayyuhā al-Maẓlūm al-Masjūn. Ashhadu annaka ikhtarta al-balāʾ li-najāti man fī malakūti al-inshāʾ wa sakanta fī al-sijn li-khalāṣi man ʿalā al-arḍ. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Muqtadir ʿalā mā tashāʾ wa fī qabḍatika zimāmu al-asmāʾ. Innaka anta al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
When you receive My verses and perceive the fragrance of My utterance, say: Glory be to You, the Wronged One, the Imprisoned! I bear witness that You chose affliction for the salvation of all in the kingdom of creation and dwelt in prison for the deliverance of all on earth. There is no god but You, who have power over whatever You will, and in Your grasp are the reins of the names. You indeed are the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.
:::

### 101

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اسئلک یا سرّ الوجود و یا من فی قبضتک زمام الغیب و الشّهود بأن تؤیّدنی علی ما یلیق لأمرک البدیع و ینبغی لیومک العزیز ثمّ اکتب لی بجودک و الطافک ما یحفظنی عن النّعیق الّذی اخبرت به و بطغیانه ای ربّ انا العاجز البائس القائم لدی باب رحمتک اسئلک ان لا تحرمنی عمّا عندک لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المتعالی العزیز العلیم الحمد لک یا مقصود العارفین و محبوب من فی السّموات و الأرضین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Asʾaluka yā Sirra al-wujūd wa yā man fī qabḍatika zimāmu al-ghayb wa al-shuhūd bi-an tuʾayyidanī ʿalā mā yalīqu li-amrika al-badīʿ wa yanbaghī li-yawmika al-ʿazīz. Thumma uktub lī bi-jūdika wa alṭāfika mā yaḥfaẓunī ʿan al-naʿīq alladhī akhbarta bihi wa bi-ṭughyānihi. Ay Rabb, anā al-ʿājiz al-bāʾis al-qāʾim ladā bābi raḥmatika. Asʾaluka an lā taḥrimanī ʿammā ʿindaka. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Muqtadir al-Mutaʿālī al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAlīm. Al-ḥamdu laka yā Maqṣūda al-ʿārifīn wa Maḥbūba man fī al-samāwāt wa al-arḍīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
I ask You, Mystery of existence, in whose grasp are the reins of the unseen and the seen, to assist me in doing what befits Your wondrous Cause and is worthy of Your mighty Day. Then, through Your generosity and gracious favors, decree for me what will protect me from the croaking one whose coming and rebellion You foretold. O Lord, I am the helpless, wretched one standing at the door of Your mercy. I ask You not to deprive me of what is with You. There is no god but You, the All-Powerful, the Most Exalted, the Almighty, the All-Knowing. Praise be to You, Desire of those who know You and Beloved of all in the heavens and the earths. End of quotation.
:::

### 102

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه ذکر آثار حضرت افنان آقای م علیه من کلّ بهآء ابهاه فرموده بودند مخصوص ایشان الواح بدیعهٴ منیعهٴ مقدّسهٴ مبارکه نازل و از قبل ارسال شد و اینکه خدمات ایشانرا نوشته بودید معلوم و واضح است در آن ارض نفوسی موجودند که لدی اللّه از ایادی امر محسوبند نظر بحکمت بر حسب ظاهر ستر فرمودند ولکن عند اهل ملأ اعلی کمال معروفیّت را دارند لأنّ المقصود نسبهم الیه فی الواح شتّی آنچه در ذکر ایشان مرقوم داشتند جمیع عرض شد لسان عظمت باینکلمهٴ علیا ناطق قوله جلّ جلاله لدی الوجه مذکورند و از قلم اعلی در صحیفهٴ حمرا مسطور انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dhekr-e āthār-e Ḥaḍrat-e Afnān Āqā-ye M, ʿalayhi min kulli bahāʾin abhāhu, farmūde būdand, makhṣūṣ-e īshān alvāḥ-e badīʿe-ye manīʿe-ye moqaddase-ye mobārake nāzel va az qabl ersāl shod. Va īnke khadamāt-e īshān rā neveshte būdīd, maʿlūm va vāḍeḥ ast. Dar ān arḍ nofūsī mawjūdand ke ladā Allāh az Ayādī-ye Amr maḥsūband. Naẓar be-ḥekmat bar ḥasab-e ẓāher satr farmūdand, va lāken ʿenda ahl-e malaʾ-e aʿlā kamāl-e maʿrūfiyyat rā dārand, li-anna al-Maqṣūd nasabahum ilayhi fī alwāḥin shattā. Ānche dar dhekr-e īshān marqūm dāshtand jamīʿ ʿarḍ shod. Lesān-e ʿaẓamat be-īn kaleme-ye ʿolyā nāṭeq. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu: Ladā al-vajh madhkūrand va az qalam-e aʿlā dar ṣaḥīfe-ye ḥamrā masṭūr. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to your mention of the writings of his honor the Afnán, Áqá M., upon him be the most glorious of all glory, wondrous, exalted, holy, and blessed Tablets were revealed especially for him and sent previously. As to what you wrote of his services, these are known and evident. In that land there are souls who are counted before God among the Hands of the Cause. For wisdom’s sake, He has outwardly kept them concealed, but they are fully known among the Concourse on high, for the Desired One has associated them with Himself in various Tablets. Everything you wrote concerning him was presented. The Tongue of Grandeur spoke these exalted words. His words, exalted be His glory: “He is remembered in Our presence and inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Scroll.” End of quotation.
:::

### 103

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و ذکر مخدّره امة‌اللّه بی‌بی صاحب علیها بهآء اللّه نموده بودند هذا ما نزّل لها من ملکوت بیان ربّنا الرّحمن قوله جلّ جلاله و عمّ نواله
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va dhekr-e mokhaddare Amat Allāh Bībī Ṣāḥeb, ʿalayhā bahāʾu Allāh, namūde būdand. Hādhā mā nuzzila lahā min malakūti bayāni Rabbinā al-Raḥmān. Qawluhu jalla jalāluhu wa ʿamma nawāluhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
You had also mentioned the honored lady, the handmaid of God, Bíbí Ṣáḥib, upon her be the glory of God. This is what was sent down for her from the kingdom of the utterance of our Lord, the All-Merciful. His words, exalted be His glory and all-embracing His bounty:
:::

### 104

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بنام دانای یکتا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Be-nām-e Dānā-ye Yektā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of the One, the All-Knowing.
:::

### 105

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا امتی حقّ جلّ جلاله مهربانست فضلش کل را احاطه نموده و همچنین علمش صدائی مرتفع نمیشود مگر آنکه جواب از ملکوت بیان رحمن نازل اناث را بکلمهٴ مبارکهٴ یا امتی مزیّن فرموده و رجال را بکلمهٴ بدیعهٴ منیعهٴ یا عبدی مطرّز داشته چه بسیار از خلق اوّلین و آخرین بسبب اصغاء اینکلمه جان انفاق نمودند اینکلمه بمثابهٴ نهالی است که ید قدرت آنرا غرس نموده باید بآب محبّت و استقامت سقایه شود و باسم حقّ از اریاح سمومیّه محفوظ ماند قدر اینکلمه را بدان لعمر اللّه اگر جمیع عالم ادراک نمایند کل مشتعل شوند و بافق اعلی توجّه نمایند جمیع اماء آن ارض را تکبیر میرسانیم و کل را بتقدیس و تنزیه و عمل به ما انزلناه فی الکتاب وصیّت مینمائیم طوبی للعاملین و العاملات انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā amatī, Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu mehrabānast. Faḍlash koll rā eḥāṭe namūde va hamchenīn ʿelmash. Ṣedāʾī mortafeʿ nemī-shavad magar ānke javāb az malakūt-e bayān-e Raḥmān nāzel. Enāth rā be-kaleme-ye mobārake-ye yā amatī mozayyan farmūde va rejāl rā be-kaleme-ye badīʿe-ye manīʿe-ye yā ʿabdī moṭarraz dāshte. Che besyār az khalq-e avvalīn va ākherīn be-sabab-e eṣghā-ye īn kaleme jān enfāq namūdand. Īn kaleme be-mathābe-ye nahālī ast ke yad-e qodrat ān rā ghars namūde. Bāyad be-āb-e maḥabbat va esteqāmat seqāye shavad va be-esm-e Ḥaqq az aryāḥ-e samūmiyye maḥfūẓ mānad. Qadr-e īn kaleme rā bedān. La-ʿamru Allāh, agar jamīʿ-e ʿālam edrāk namāyand koll moshtaʿel shavand va be-ofoq-e aʿlā tavajjoh namāyand. Jamīʿ-e emā-ye ān arḍ rā takbīr mī-rasānīm va koll rā be-taqdīs va tanzīh va ʿamal be-mā anzalnāhu fī al-kitāb vaṣiyyat mī-namāyīm. Ṭūbā li-al-ʿāmilīn wa al-ʿāmilāt. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O My handmaid! God, exalted be His glory, is kind. His bounty encompasses all, as does His knowledge. No voice is raised without an answer descending from the kingdom of the All-Merciful’s utterance. He has adorned women with the blessed words “O My handmaid” and clothed men in the wondrous and exalted words “O My servant.” How many among the peoples of earlier and later times have laid down their lives to hear these words! These words are like a sapling planted by the hand of power. It must be watered with the water of love and steadfastness and kept safe, in the name of God, from scorching winds. Appreciate the worth of these words. By the life of God, if the whole world were to understand, all would be set aflame and turn toward the most exalted horizon. We convey Our greetings to all the handmaids in that land and exhort them all to holiness, purity, and action in accordance with what We have sent down in the Book. Blessed are the men and women who act accordingly. End of quotation.
:::

### 106

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ذکر جناب حاجی محمّد حسین علیه بهآء اللّه را نموده بودند ذکر ایشان در ساحت امنع اقدس بشرف اصغا فائز هذا ما نزّل له من لدن منزل حکیم قوله عزّ ذکره و جلّ بیانه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhekr-e Janāb-e Ḥājī Moḥammad Ḥosayn, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh, rā namūde būdand. Dhekr-e īshān dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas be-sharaf-e eṣghā fāʾez. Hādhā mā nuzzila lahu min ladun Munzilin Ḥakīm. Qawluhu ʿazza dhikruhu wa jalla bayānuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
You had mentioned Ḥájí Muḥammad Ḥusayn, upon him be the glory of God. The mention of him was honored with a hearing in the most holy, most inaccessible court. This is what was sent down for him by the All-Wise Revealer. His words, exalted be His remembrance and glorious His utterance:
:::

### 107

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المشرق من الأفق الأعلی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismī al-Mushriq min al-ufuq al-aʿlā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, shining from the most exalted horizon.
:::

### 108

::: {.original lang="fa"}
هر نفسی الیوم بعرفان فائز شد او در ملکوت بیان لدی الرّحمن مذکور است جمیع عالم از برای یوم اللّه خلق شده و چون اسم اعظم بقوّهٴ غالبه خرق حجاب نمود کل غافل و محجوب مشاهده گشتند الّا من شآء اللّه امروز روزیست که در هر نفسی آنچه مستور است ظاهر و هویدا گردد یوم تبلی السّرائر امروز است و یوم فیه تمرّ الجبال امروز است هر مکنونی آشکار شود و هر مستوری هویدا طوبی از برای نفسیکه بنار محبّت الهی مشتعل شد اشتعالیکه سطوت و قدرت و شوکت اهل انشاء و شبهات و اشارات علما او را از مالک اسماء منع ننمود و از بحر معانی محروم نساخت هر عملی الیوم فی سبیل اللّه ظاهر شود اثرش ببقاء ملک و ملکوت باقی و دائم است یا حزب اللّه جهد نمائید تا فائز شوید بآنچه سزاوار یوم حقّ جلّ جلاله است قدر بیان رحمن را بدان و چون جان حفظش نما البهآء من لدنّا علیک و علی احبّائی هناک الّذین ما خوّفتهم شوکة المعتدین و ما اضعفتهم قوّة المعرضین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Har nafsī al-yawm bi-ʿirfān fāʾiz shud ū dar malakūt-i bayān ladā al-Raḥmān madhkūr ast. Jamīʿ-i ʿālam az barā-yi yawm Allāh khalq shudih va chūn ism-i aʿẓam bi-quvvih-yi ghālibih kharq-i ḥijāb namūd kull ghāfil va maḥjūb mushāhadih gashtand illā man shāʾ Allāh. Imrūz rūzīst kih dar har nafsī ānchih mastūr ast ẓāhir va huvaydā gardad. Yawm tublā al-sarāʾir imrūz ast va yawm fīhi tamurr al-jibāl imrūz ast. Har maknūnī āshkār shavad va har mastūrī huvaydā. Ṭūbā az barā-yi nafsī kih bi-nār-i maḥabbat-i ilāhī mushtaʿil shud, ishtiʿālī kih saṭvat va qudrat va shawkat-i ahl-i inshā va shubahāt va ishārāt-i ʿulamā ū rā az Mālik-i asmā manʿ nanamūd va az baḥr-i maʿānī maḥrūm nasākht. Har ʿamalī al-yawm fī sabīl Allāh ẓāhir shavad atharash bi-baqā-yi mulk va malakūt bāqī va dāʾim ast. Yā ḥizb Allāh jahd namāyīd tā fāʾiz shavīd bi-ānchih sazāvār-i yawm-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ast. Qadr-i bayān-i Raḥmān rā bidān va chūn jān ḥifẓash namā. Al-Bahāʾ min ladunnā ʿalayka wa-ʿalā aḥibbāʾī hunāka alladhīna mā khawwafathum shawkat al-muʿtadīn wa-mā aḍʿafathum quwwat al-muʿriḍīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Every soul who has attained recognition today is remembered before the All-Merciful in the kingdom of utterance. The entire world was created for the Day of God, yet when the Most Great Name rent the veil through His all-subduing power, all were found heedless and veiled, except those whom God willed. Today is the day when whatever is concealed within every soul becomes manifest and plain. The day when secrets are laid bare is today, and the day when the mountains pass away is today. Every hidden thing is revealed, and everything concealed is made plain. Blessed is the soul who has been set ablaze with the fire of divine love, with such a flame that neither the might, power, and majesty of the people of creation nor the doubts and insinuations of the learned have kept that soul from the Lord of Names or deprived it of the ocean of meanings. Every deed performed today in the path of God has an influence that endures as long as the earthly and heavenly kingdoms endure. O people of God, strive to attain what befits the Day of the True One, exalted be His glory. Appreciate the utterance of the All-Merciful and guard it as you would your own life. Glory from Us be upon you and upon My loved ones there, whom the might of the aggressors has not frightened and the power of those who turn away has not weakened. End.
:::

### 109

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ذکر جناب آقا سیّد صادق و آقا سیّد یوسف و آقا ابوالقاسم و آقا سیّد علیرضا علیهم بهآء اللّه را نموده بودند تلقاء وجه عرض شد و مخصوص هر یک نازل شد آنچه که بدوام اسماء حسنی باقی و پاینده است هذا ما نزّل لجناب سیّد صادق قوله عزّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhikr-i Jināb-i Āqā Siyyid Ṣādiq va Āqā Siyyid Yūsuf va Āqā Abu’l-Qāsim va Āqā Siyyid ʿAlī-Riḍā ʿalayhim Bahāʾ Allāh rā namūdih būdand. Tilqāʾ-i vajh ʿarḍ shud va makhṣūṣ-i har yak nāzil shud ānchih kih bi-davām-i asmā-yi ḥusnā bāqī va pāyandih ast. Hādhā mā nuzzila li-Jināb-i Siyyid Ṣādiq, qawluhu ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
You had mentioned Áqá Siyyid Ṣádiq, Áqá Siyyid Yúsuf, Áqá Abu’l-Qásim, and Áqá Siyyid ʿAlí-Riḍá, upon them be the glory of God. This was presented in His presence, and for each one in particular there was revealed that which will endure as long as the most beautiful names endure. This is what was sent down for Siyyid Ṣádiq. His words, exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 110

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو الباقی الدّائم الأبدیّ الأحدیّ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-Bāqī al-Dāʾim al-Abadī al-Aḥadī.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Everlasting, the Enduring, the Eternal, the One.
:::

### 111

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ذکر من لدنّا لمن ذکره الأمین لیفرح بعنایة ربّه و یکون من الشّاکرین انّ الّذی فاز الیوم بآیاتی انّه فاز بکلّ الخیر یشهد بذلک من عنده کتاب عظیم یا صادق انّا اقبلنا الیک من شطر السّجن و انزلنا لک ما یهدی العباد الی صراطی المستقیم قل یا قوم ضعوا ما عندکم قد ظهر ما کان مکنوناً فی العلم و مسطوراً فی کتاب اللّه ربّ العالمین کذلک انزلنا الآیات و صرّفناها بالحقّ و ارسلناها الیک هدیّة من محبوبک الجمیل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhikr min ladunnā li-man dhakarahu al-Amīn li-yafraḥa bi-ʿināyat rabbihi wa-yakūna min al-shākirīn. Inna alladhī fāza al-yawm bi-āyātī innahu fāza bi-kull al-khayr. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man ʿindahu kitāb ʿaẓīm. Yā Ṣādiq innā aqbalnā ilayka min shaṭr al-sijn wa-anzalnā laka mā yahdī al-ʿibād ilā ṣirāṭī al-mustaqīm. Qul yā qawm ḍaʿū mā ʿindakum qad ẓahara mā kāna maknūnan fī al-ʿilm wa-masṭūran fī kitāb Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn. Kadhālika anzalnā al-āyāt wa-ṣarrafnāhā bi-al-ḥaqq wa-arsalnāhā ilayka hadiyyatan min maḥbūbika al-Jamīl.
:::

::: {.translation}
A remembrance from Us for the one whom Amín has mentioned, that he may rejoice in the loving care of his Lord and be among the thankful. Whoever has attained My verses today has indeed attained all good. To this bears witness the One with whom is a mighty Book. O Ṣádiq, We have turned toward you from the direction of the prison and have sent down for you what guides the servants to My straight path. Say: O people, set aside what you possess. What was concealed in knowledge and inscribed in the Book of God, the Lord of the worlds, has now appeared. Thus have We sent down the verses, expounded them in truth, and sent them to you as a gift from your Beloved, the All-Beauteous.
:::

### 112

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر یوسف فضلاً من لدنّا و انا الفضّال الکریم یا یوسف دع ما عند القوم و خذ ما اوتیت من لدن ربّک الفضّال القدیم لا تعادل بحرف من آیاتی کنوز الأرض یشهد بذلک کلّ عارف بصیر البهآء من لدنّا \[علی الّذین\] ما نقضوا میثاق اللّه و عهده الا انّهم من الرّاسخین فی کتاب مبین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru Yūsuf faḍlan min ladunnā wa-anā al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm. Yā Yūsuf daʿ mā ʿinda al-qawm wa-khudh mā ūtīta min ladun rabbika al-Faḍḍāl al-Qadīm. Lā tuʿādil bi-ḥarf min āyātī kunūz al-arḍ. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kull ʿārif baṣīr. Al-Bahāʾ min ladunnā \[ʿalā alladhīna\] mā naqaḍū mīthāq Allāh wa-ʿahdahu alā innahum min al-rāsikhīn fī kitāb mubīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
And We remember Yúsuf as a token of Our grace, and I am the Most Bountiful, the All-Generous. O Yúsuf, leave aside what the people possess and take what you have been given by your Lord, the Most Bountiful, the Ancient. Do not reckon the treasures of the earth equal to a single letter of My verses. Every discerning soul endowed with insight bears witness to this. Glory from Us be \[upon those who\] have not broken God’s covenant and His pledge. Truly, they are numbered among the steadfast in a clear Book.
:::

### 113

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و هذا ما نزّل لجناب ابوالقاسم قوله جلّ و عزّ
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va hādhā mā nuzzila li-Jināb-i Abu’l-Qāsim, qawluhu jalla wa-ʿazza.
:::

::: {.translation}
And this is what was sent down for Abu’l-Qásim. His words, glorified and exalted be He:
:::

### 114

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو المشفق الرّحیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-Mushfiq al-Raḥīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Compassionate, the Merciful.
:::

### 115

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا اباالقاسم قدر ایّام را بدان و بما ینبغی قیام نما امروز خلق نیکو و عمل پاک سبب اعلاء کلمهٴ الهی است جمیع دوستان باید حقّ مظلوم را بآن نصرت نمایند و در جمیع احوال در صدد ارتفاع امر باشند اینست وصیّت ما از قبل و بعد از حقّ میطلبیم کل را مشتعل فرماید اشتعالیکه ظلم ظالمان و ضوضاء جاهلان آنرا منع ننماید هر نفسی بیک قطره از این بحر فائز شد جنود عالم و مدافع امم قادر بر منع او نبوده و نیست حقّ علیم شهادت میدهد و باینکلمهٴ علیا نطق میفرماید طوبی لکلّ سامع مجیب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Abā al-Qāsim qadr-i ayyām rā bidān va bi-mā yanbaghī qiyām namā. Imrūz khulq-i nīkū va ʿamal-i pāk sabab-i iʿlā-yi kalimih-yi ilāhī ast. Jamīʿ-i dūstān bāyad Ḥaqq-i maẓlūm rā bi-ān nuṣrat namāyand va dar jamīʿ-i aḥvāl dar ṣadad-i irtifāʿ-i amr bāshand. Īnast vaṣiyyat-i mā az qabl va baʿd. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm kull rā mushtaʿil farmāyad, ishtiʿālī kih ẓulm-i ẓālimān va ḍawḍā-yi jāhilān ānrā manʿ nanamāyad. Har nafsī bi-yak qaṭrih az īn baḥr fāʾiz shud junūd-i ʿālam va madāfiʿ-i umam qādir bar manʿ-i ū nabūdih va nīst. Ḥaqq-i ʿalīm shahādat mīdihad va bi-īn kalimih-yi ʿulyā nuṭq mīfarmāyad: Ṭūbā li-kull sāmiʿ mujīb.
:::

::: {.translation}
